settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
Our Advent Calendar is back and better than ever before. Even more varieties and spirits than last year, a new flavour unlike any other Moonshine and exclusive products that will surely put a smile on your face.

For the same price as last year you can look forward to new exclusive high-quality products in the Advent Calendar - the total value of the included products is over £200!

Attention, our Advent Calendar has sold out every past year, so order quickly to surely receive your Moonshine Advent Calendar.

settings.heading: Shipping
settings.content:
Shipping for the for the Advent Calendar is FREE

Shipping takes place in 1 - 2 business days

Please note, Advent Calendars are shipped separately from other items in your order

settings.heading: Ingredients & Allergens
settings.content:
Our Advent Calendar is not 100% vegan or allergen free as the Calendar includes at least one Moonshine variety that contains milk and one product that contains nuts.

For more information please feel free to email us on info@odonnellmoonshine.co.uk.

Calendar expiry date: 05/31/2025

settings.heading: Content - *SPOILER ALERT*
settings.content:
Attention, only read on if you want to know what you can look forward to in the new Advent Calendar.

Content:
Tough Nut 350ml + Pouring Lid, 2x Tough Nut Mini, 2x Micro Christmas Tree Decorations, Discount Code, 2x Wild Berry Mini, Moonshine Cookies, 2x Very Cherry Mini, Sticky Toffee Mini, 2x Cookie Cutters, Passionfruit Mini, Roasted Apple Mini, O’Donnell Flask, Peach Mini, Macadmia Mini, "O’Donnell Shot" Keychain, Blood Orange Mini, Cookie Mini, "Sweet & Salty" Nut Cream 350ml, Ice cube tray, Baseball, Salted Toffee Cream 700ml

settings.text: This year's Moonshine Advent Calendar includes all our best flavours, loads of new and exclusive products, and, of course, a brand new flavour only included in the calendar. It doesn't matter whether you're new to Moonshine or a long-time fan, the Advent Calendar is sure to delight with great flavour and wonderful surprises in store for everyone. It is made of climate-neutral cardboard and, as always we have prioritised excellent product quality.

The perfect early Christmas gift for yourself and your loved ones. This year, you can get our Advent Calendar on our Early Bird offer as a twin-pack. If you're one of the first 250 to order you can save £40 by buying two Advent Calendars for £198!

settings.heading: The O'Donnell Moonshine Micro Advent Calendar!

settings.text: Calling all Moonshiners, our Micro advent calendar includes 24 micros to liven up the countdown to Christmas! Including a wide variety of our fan favourites, as well as a brand new flavour! Beautifully packaged, making it the perfect gift to treat loved ones, or to treat yourself!

settings.heading: What's included in this year's Calendar?

settings.text: This is a surprise we don't intend to take away from you. You can look forward to all your favourite flavours and exclusive products you won't have seen before. The products included are worth a total of over £200! Should you really not be able to wait to find out, you can find the spoiler section near the product description.

settings.heading: When will the Advent Calendars be delivered?
settings.row_content: Shipping of our Advent Calendars will begin during the latter part of September.

settings.heading: Why have I received a shipping confirmation mail?
settings.row_content: You will receive the confirmation mail earlier but the shipping will commence in the second half of September.

settings.heading: Why is the Advent Calendar not part of my delivery?
settings.row_content: Should you order more products along with your Advent Calendar, these will be shipped separately from each other. So you will receive the other products earlier than the Advent Calendar.

settings.heading: I'm still missing Calendars!
settings.row_content: Should you have ordered more than two Advent Calendars please be aware that these are usually shipped in packs of two. So when ordering four Calendars for example, you will receive two separate shipments of two.

settings.heading: I ordered two Advent Calendars but haven't received a discount.
settings.row_content:
You will only receive the discount when specifically ordering the Early Bird Two-Pack of our Advent Calendars.

It's also not possible to make two separate orders of Single Advent Calendars a Two-Pack with a discount.

settings.heading: Can I use a discount code?
settings.row_content: Our Twin Pack Advent Calendars are not combinable with other discounts as this product is already heavily discounted. You can however use Proof Points and discount codes on our single calendar.

settings.heading: Can I have an Early Bird Two-Pack sent to two different addresses?
settings.row_content: No, per order you can only use one shipping address.
